ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: COMMUNITY/EVENT PROGRAM - THIS ENCOMPASSES OUR PROGRAMS THROUGHOUT THE REGION THAT ARE DESIGN FOCUSED AND PART OF THE WDC DESIGNATION. ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: GRANT PROGRAM - THIS PROGRAM AIMS TO SUPPORT LOCAL ORGANIZATIONS AND BUSINESSES IN DELIVERING COMMUNITY-DRIVEN DESIGN ACTIVITIES THAT ENGAGE DIVERSE COMMUNITIES ACROSS THE CITY AND ALIGN WITH THE OBJECTIVES AND OUTCOMES OF WDC 2024. THE PROGRAM INCLUDES GRANTS TO LOCAL ORGANIZATIONS AS WELL AS MONEY TO CONSTRUCT OUR WDC 2024 PAVILION AND SUPPORT FOR ADMINISTERING THE OVERALL PROGRAM AND ITS OBJECTIVES.
